PreToolUse.command: if echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE '^make (goss-test|test)'; then docker compose ps -q 2>/dev/null | head -1 >/dev/null || echo '[Hook] Warning: No containers running. Run make up first.'; fi

PostToolUse.command: if echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE '(Dockerfile|compose\.yaml|compose\.override|compose\.production|\.env\.example|entrypoint)'; then echo '[Hook] Config file changed. Remember: make build && make down && make up'; fi
if echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE 'git commit'; then echo '[Hook] Commit done. Update session log if not already done.'; fi
